item.title: New Site, Same Robots
item.description: It's been a minute. The last time I overhauled this site was 2015 and a whole lot has happened since, so it was time. The new site is live, it's fast, and for the first time it actually knows what a Vision Pro is.

item.title: Radial Menu is Open Source
item.description: While building Quads I needed a radial menu that didn't feel arbitrary, and I ended up going way down the rabbit hole on it. So I've pulled it out into its own repo and put it on GitHub for anyone to use.

item.title: Introducing Quads
item.description: OK, here's the big one I've been hinting at for over a year. Quads is a box modeler for Apple Vision Pro, and it's the app I've wanted since the first time I put the headset on.

item.title: Lost in the Backrooms
item.description: Second immersive environment for the site is live and this one is a little more unsettling. Sketchbot has wandered into the Backrooms.

item.title: TRON Immersive: End of Line
item.description: The original TRON ignited my passion for computer animation when I first saw it at 16 in 1982. With TRON: Ares hitting theaters this week, I decided to create an homage to the original as a proof of concept for my first spatial website environment for Apple Vision Pro.

item.title: VRNavDemo: Figuring Out Navigation on Vision Pro
item.description: First bit of code I've put out in public! VRNavDemo is a small sandbox for testing camera navigation models on Vision Pro, and it's up on my GitHub.

item.title: Vision Pro Arrives at the Studio
item.description: Well, I did it. After a year of watching from the sidelines I picked up an Apple Vision Pro and it's been living on my desk ever since. I have a lot of thoughts.

item.title: ZBrush for iPad First Impressions
item.description: ZBrush for iPad dropped and I've been sculpting on the couch all week. Here's the first real test, an alien head that I started as a quick doodle and kept pushing.

item.title: Happy Halloween: SkullBot and Candy Corn Bot
item.description: Couldn't let October go by without at least a couple of seasonal 'bots. SkullBot got a V2 pass this year and Candy Corn Bot is brand new.

item.title: Hex Mesh Studies
item.description: A little side project that got out of hand. I've been playing with hex based meshes in ZBrush as a way to get sci-fi surface detail without hand placing every panel, and it turned into a whole series.

item.title: The Museum of Untold Possibilities
item.description: Here it is, the big one. I've submitted The Museum of Untold Possibilities to the Epic MegaGrants program and I've put the full pitch up on the site for anyone who wants to read it.

item.title: Afternoon At The Museum
item.description: I've been spending a lot of nights and weekends in Unreal Engine this year and this is the first thing to come out of it that I'm happy to share. Afternoon At The Museum is a real-time proof of concept where the Eye Pilots explore a museum full of my robot work.

item.title: SCOOB! Mean Machine 3D Concept Tests
item.description: With SCOOB! out now I can share some 3D concept tests I did for Dick Dastardly's Mean Machine for Warner Animation Group.

item.title: Jammin' Alpacas
item.description: Been heads down on this one for a while and can finally show some stills. Jammin' Alpacas is a stylized animated short featuring a band of alpacas, a space billboard and plenty of attitude.

item.title: Happy Holidays from Sketchbot Studios
item.description: It's been a busy year here in LA and I'm looking forward to a little downtime with the family. Thanks to all the clients and fellow artists who made 2018 a good one. Here's Sketchbot doing his part with the lights.

item.title: Cell Characters for GIBCO
item.description: Just wrapped a really enjoyable character design gig for GIBCO, the cell culture brand from Thermo Fisher Scientific. The ask was to turn cells into appealing characters that could carry a bunch of their media without getting too cartoony for a science audience.

item.title: Adobe VR Bot
item.description: Here's a 'bot I designed and rendered for the folks at Adobe to help promote their VR storytelling tools. The brief was a robot painting in VR, so naturally he got a headset, a pair of controllers and a neon lit warehouse to work in.

item.title: TikiBot
item.description: TikiBot started as a doodle in my sketchbook a couple months back and I kept coming back to it, so this week I finally blocked him out in ZBrush.

item.title: Meet M4Y4, the New Autodesk Maya Mascot
item.description: I'm finally able to share this one! Autodesk brought me on to design, model and render the new mascot for the Maya Learning Channel, and M4Y4 is now officially out in the wild.

item.title: Nuthin' But Mech 4
item.description: Volume 4 of Nuthin' But Mech is out now from Design Studio Press and I'm honored to be included once again alongside some incredibly talented mech designers.

item.title: March of Robots 2016 Wrap-Up
item.description: Another March in the books! This was my third go at Dacosta Bayley's March of Robots and I managed to get 27 'bots out the door, which is a personal best. A few days got skipped due to client deadlines, but that's how it goes when you're freelancing.
